title: Aureline M5 retirement manifest
description: Canonical per-domain retirement manifest for a supported line or stable-facing capability reaching Retired. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the last-supported version or channel pinned to an exact build, the cutoff date, the successor path routed forward, the disable path exposed, and the support-note closure state so the class never disappears silently and no new install or new tenant can still select it. Downstream release, help, docs, support, marketplace, install, and partner/procurement surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's retirement transition by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
